lessons.title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut
lessons.title_zh: 安索普向投資人揭露營收暴增，迎向股票上市

paragraphs.en: The artificial intelligence giant Anthropic revealed that its revenue grew significantly by forty-five percent to sixteen point eight billion US dollars in the three months leading up to September. These financial details were shared by the Claude-developer during a meeting with prospective investors at its headquarters in San Francisco, as the company prepares for a stock market listing before the year ends.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧巨頭安索普（Anthropic）透露，在截至九月的三個月中，其營收顯著成長了百分之四十五，達到一百六十八億美元。這些財務細節是由這位「克勞德」（Claude）開發商在舊金山總部與潛在投資人會面時分享的，當時該公司正為今年底前的股票上市作準備。

paragraphs.en: This development happens while some technology stocks, including hardware makers that build data center equipment, have experienced drops recently because of worries about huge spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Meanwhile, Anthropic stated that it achieved a profit for the second quarter in a row, with quarterly revenue having climbed steadily throughout this year.
paragraphs.zh: 這項發展發生在某些科技股（包括製造資料中心設備的硬體製造商）最近因為擔心人工智慧基礎設施的鉅額支出而下跌之際。同時，安索普表示其連續第二季實現獲利，且本年度的季度營收持續穩步攀升。

paragraphs.en: The financial results from this firm and its rival OpenAI provide an important way to measure the industry growth and its financial capacity to build necessary technology. However, share prices for major chip makers like AMD, Nvidia, and Intel declined sharply. Asian markets also felt the impact, as Japanese investment firm Softbank and South Korean semiconductor giants Samsung and SK Hynix saw their shares drop significantly.
paragraphs.zh: 這家公司及其對手開放人工智慧（OpenAI）的財務結果，提供了衡量產業成長及建立所需技術之財務能力的重要方式。然而，像是超微（AMD）、輝達（Nvidia）和英特爾（Intel）等主要晶片製造商的股價急劇下跌。亞洲市場也感受到衝擊，日本投資公司軟體銀行（Softbank）以及南韓半導體巨頭三星（Samsung）和SK海力士（SK Hynix）的股價都大幅下跌。

paragraphs.en: These market drops followed remarks made by Broadcom chief executive Hock Tan, who stated that many investors have no clue and are acting as if they are in a casino. Additional concerns involve the safety of artificial intelligence models. While OpenAI delayed its public offering to address safety issues, Anthropic has also urged that development should slow down, even as it continues expanding globally by opening a new office in Singapore.
paragraphs.zh: 這些市場跌幅是繼博通（Broadcom）執行長陳福陽（Hock Tan）針對人工智慧支出發表言論之後出現的。陳福陽在新加坡的一場會議上表示，許多投資人毫無頭緒，其設定極端的期望「就像在賭場一樣」。其他擔憂則涉及人工智慧模型的安全性。當開放人工智慧延遲其公開上市以解決安全問題時，安索普也敦促應放慢開發速度，儘管它仍透過在新加坡開設新辦事處來繼續全球擴張。

grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞子句補充說明硬體製造商。
grammar.example: This development happens while some technology stocks, including hardware makers that build data center equipment, have experienced drops recently because of worries about huge spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.

grammar.explain: 使用被動語態表達財務細節是由開發商分享的。
grammar.example: These financial details were shared by the Claude-developer during a meeting with prospective investors at its headquarters in San Francisco, as the company prepares for a stock market listing before the year ends.

lessons.title: Wales has a school standards crisis. Will plans to fix it actually work?
lessons.title_zh: 威爾斯正面臨學校標準危機。解決它的計畫真的會成功嗎？

paragraphs.en: A brand new school complex recently opened in Wales, but this positive development comes at a difficult time. According to the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa), a global testing system that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science, Wales ranked the worst among United Kingdom nations. This result has shocked many educators and parents, especially as secondary school application deadlines approach. The data reveals that Welsh fifteen-year-olds are roughly two years behind students in England in major subjects, prompting serious questions about why the regional education system is lagging.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯最近啟用了一座嶄新的學校複合體，但這項正面的發展卻出現在一個艱難的時刻。根據評估青少年閱讀、數學和科學能力的全球考試系統「國際學生能力評量計畫」（Pisa），威爾斯在英國各國中排名墊底。這個結果震驚了許多教育工作者和家長，特別是在中學入學申請截止日期逼近之際。資料顯示，威爾斯十五歲學生的表現大約落後英格蘭學生兩個學年，這引發了關於為何該地區教育系統落後的嚴肅質疑。

paragraphs.en: Education in Wales has been managed by the devolved administration since nineteen ninety-nine. Over the years, leaders have made major changes, such as removing league tables and standardized tests to try a different approach from England. However, poor test results in two thousand and ten led to a return of accountability measures, including annual reading and maths tests. Later, these policies changed again as officials focused on developing a completely new curriculum, which some experts now view as a major distraction from core academic standards.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯的教育自一九九九年起由地方自治政府管理。多年來，領導階層做出了重大改變，例如取消排行榜與標準化測驗，試圖採用與英格蘭不同的方法。然而，二〇一〇年不佳的考試成績導致問責措施重新回歸，包括每年一次的閱讀與數學測驗。隨後，隨著官員們將焦點轉向開發全新的課程，這些政策再次改變，有些專家現在認為這分流了對核心學術標準的注意力。

paragraphs.en: Some international education experts argue that weak accountability is the main reason for the poor rankings. While England introduced structured phonics and clear directions for teachers, Wales chose to give schools complete freedom to design their own curricula. Critics explain that this lack of clear guidance creates wide inconsistencies between schools and can harm disadvantaged pupils the most. Teachers who are already dealing with tight budgets and student behavior issues have struggled under this heavy responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 一些國際教育專家主張，薄弱的問責制是排名不佳的主要原因。英格蘭引入了結構化的自然發音法與給老師的明確指示，而威爾斯則選擇賦予學校完全的自由來設計自己的課程。批評者解釋說，缺乏明確指引會在學校之間造成巨大的不一致，並且對弱勢學生的傷害最大。已經在應付吃緊的預算與學生行為問題的教師，在這個沉重的責任下掙扎。

paragraphs.en: Beyond teaching methods and curriculum design, structural issues within local government may also play a role. Unlike England, Wales has no academies, and education is run by twenty-two local councils. Former leaders admit that having so many small councils makes it difficult to provide the right level of guidance and challenge. As officials and educators reflect on these challenges, everyone agrees that finding effective ways to support teachers and students is essential before the next global tests take place.
paragraphs.zh: 除了教學方法與課程設計之外，地方政府內部的結構性問題可能也扮演了一定的角色。與英格蘭不同，威爾斯沒有獨立學校，教育是由二十二個地方委員會營運。前領導人坦言，擁有這麼多小型委員會使得提供適當水準的指導與挑戰變得困難。當官員與教育工作者反思這些挑戰時，大家都同意在下次全球考試舉行之前，找到支援老師與學生的有效方法是至關重要的。

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞 Pisa 的形容詞子句，補充說明該測驗系統的功能。
grammar.example: According to the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa), a global testing system that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science, Wales ranked the worst among United Kingdom nations.
grammar.focus: that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science

grammar.explain: 表示教育由地方自治政府所管理，主體承受動作。
grammar.example: Education in Wales has been managed by the devolved administration since nineteen ninety-nine.

grammar.point: 不定詞片語作副詞用表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達嘗試不同方法的目的。
grammar.example: Over the years, leaders have made major changes, such as removing league tables and standardized tests to try a different approach from England.
grammar.focus: to try a different approach from England

lessons.title: MAC criticizes China’s sanctions aiming at election interference
lessons.title_zh: 陸委會批評中國制裁旨在干預選舉

paragraphs.en: Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) recently stated that economic penalties imposed by Beijing on a company linked to Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Legislator Puma Shen are clear attempts to meddle in local elections. Hong Kong media outlets published reports claiming that VWAY Co, owned by the legislator's father Shen Tu-cheng, continued business operations in China despite previous penalties against another family-run firm. Following this pattern, the Taiwan Affairs Office (TAO) announced new sanctions against the enterprise.
paragraphs.zh: 臺灣的大陸委員會（MAC）近日表示，北京對與民主進步黨（DPP）立法委員沈伯洋相關的公司施加經濟懲罰，是企圖干預地方選舉的明確舉動。香港媒體先前刊登報導，聲稱由該立委父親沈土城擁有的威遠國際有限公司（VWAY Co），儘管先前另一家家族企業遭到懲罰，仍持續在中國進行商業營運。按照這種模式，中國國務院臺灣事務辦公室（TAO）隨後宣布對該企業實施新的制裁。

paragraphs.en: The MAC criticized that the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) collaborates with external media during election periods to shape public perception, target specific politicians, and apply pressure. The government emphasized that it would resolutely defend the democratic system and safeguard citizens. Meanwhile, TAO spokesman Chen Binhua claimed that the business owner ignored previous warnings and kept trading across the strait, prompting the formal ban.
paragraphs.zh: 陸委會批評中國共產黨（CCP）在選舉期間與外部媒體合作，塑造大眾觀感、針對特定政治人物並施加壓力。政府強調，將堅決捍衛民主體制並保護公民。同時，國臺辦發言人陳斌華則聲稱，該企業負責人無視先前的警告並持續進行兩岸貿易，因而促成了此一正式禁令。

paragraphs.en: In response, Puma Shen noted that the allegations are recycled claims from the previous year that have already been addressed. He explained that his family deals with Ecuador rather than China, and citizens would see through the rumors. Furthermore, the European Parliament adopted a recommendation regarding political relations that rejected efforts to restrict Taiwan's international participation, while Taiwan's coast guard vessels and military forces continued routine regional deployments.
paragraphs.zh: 對此，沈伯洋指出，這些指控是去年早已處理過的老舊說法。他解釋其家族是與厄瓜多做生意而非中國，且民眾將能看穿這些謠言。此外，歐洲議會通過了一項關於政治關係的建議案，拒絕限制臺灣參與國際組織的企圖，同時臺灣的海巡艦艇與軍事部隊則持續進行例行的區域部署。

grammar.explain: 表示主體承受動作，由「be動詞 + 過去分詞」構成。
grammar.example: The government emphasized that it would resolutely defend the democratic system and safeguard citizens.

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞作狀語，用來補充說明主句發生的同時所伴隨的狀況或動作。
grammar.example: Hong Kong media outlets published reports claiming that VWAY Co, owned by the legislator's father Shen Tu-cheng, continued business operations in China despite previous penalties against another family-run firm.

lessons.title: Talks on Taiwan-Alaska LNG deal advance
lessons.title_zh: 台美阿拉斯加液化天然氣協議談判推進

paragraphs.en: Taiwan is considering an investment reaching up to US$4.4 billion for an Alaskan liquefied natural gas project, as discussions move forward. Following a statement by US President Donald Trump about Taiwan purchasing a significant portion of the planned facility output, the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) shared details on the ongoing plans. State-run CPC Corp, Taiwan (CPC) would buy 6 million tonnes annually once operations start.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著討論向前推進，臺灣正在考慮為一項阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫投資高達44億美元。在美國總統唐納·川普發表關於臺灣將購買該計畫設施產出相當大比例的言論後，經濟部（MOEA）分享了相關進行中計畫的細節。國營的中油公司（CPC）一旦營運開始，每年將購買6MovieModal萬噸。

paragraphs.en: In addition to purchasing fuel, CPC could participate in developing the large project, which includes a long transport pipeline. Although experts question whether the massive energy plan is viable, the ministry noted that deliveries to Taiwan could begin around 2032 if schedules stay on track. Officials explained that exact investment terms and financial stakes will be decided through future commercial contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 除了購買燃料外，中油公司還可能參與開發這項包含長途輸送管線的大型計畫。儘管專家質疑這項龐大的能源計畫是否可行，但經濟部指出，如果時程保持順利，向臺灣的供貨最早可能在2032年左右開始。官員解釋說，確切的投資條件和財務股權將透過未來的商業合約來決定。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the partnership aims to diversify energy sources, improve supply security, and strengthen connections with the United States. Transporting the fuel directly across the Pacific Ocean provides an alternative route that might reduce geopolitical risks. Meanwhile, Premier Cho Jung-tai urged the public to support state-owned utility companies as officials work to ensure stable supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，此夥伴關係旨在分散能源來源、改善供應安全並加強與美國的聯繫。直接橫跨太平洋運輸燃料提供了一條可能有助於降低地緣政治風險的替代路線。同時，行政院長卓榮泰敦促大眾支持國營公用事業公司，同時官員們努力確保穩定供應。

paragraphs.en: In other international developments, the European Parliament recently adopted a recommendation regarding political relations with China. The document rejects Beijing efforts to restrict Taiwan from joining international organizations. Moreover, the Coast Guard Administration (CGA) completed a historic diplomatic voyage to Palau, sending two vessels to the distant island in a cooperative security mission.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他國際發展方面，歐洲議會最近通過了一項關於對中政治關係的建議案。該文件拒絕北京限制臺灣加入國際組織的努力。此外，海巡署（CGA）完成了對帛琉具有歷史意義的外交航行，派遣兩艘船艦前往該偏遠島嶼執行合作安全任務。

paragraphs.en: The military is also preparing to receive hundreds of defense weapons by the end of the year. According to defense officials, the first delivery includes portable missiles and launchers designed to boost air defense capabilities for Taiwan proper and outlying islands. Finally, government leaders are closely watching reports regarding rumored disease outbreaks abroad to protect public health.
paragraphs.zh: 軍方也準備在年底前接收數百件防衛武器。根據國防官員說法，第一批交貨包含便攜式飛彈與發射器，旨在提升臺灣本島與離島的防空能力。最後，政府領導人正密切關注關於海外疑似疾病爆發的報導，以保護公眾健康。

grammar.explain: 用來連接子句並修飾前方名詞的關係代名詞子句，在此補充說明管線的特徵。
grammar.example: CPC could participate in developing the large project, which includes a long transport pipeline.
grammar.focus: which includes a long transport pipeline

grammar.explain: 表示主詞承受動作，由助動詞配合過去分詞構成，強調被決定的合約條件。
grammar.example: Officials explained that exact investment terms and financial stakes will be decided through future commercial contracts.

grammar.explain: 用 V-ing 分詞片語作狀語，說明官員努力確保穩定供應時的同時發生活動。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, Premier Cho Jung-tai urged the public to support state-owned utility companies as officials work to ensure stable supplies.
grammar.focus: as officials work to ensure stable supplies

lessons.title: Resource exploration to begin in Greenland: Trump
lessons.title_zh: 川普：格陵蘭島即將展開資源探勘

paragraphs.en: US President Donald Trump stated that oil, gas, and mineral exploration is preparing to start in Greenland. He praised the arctic island as a very important location for the security of the US and Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 美國總統唐納德·川普（Donald Trump）表示，格陵蘭島的石油、天然氣和礦產探勘正準備開始。他讚揚這個北極島嶼是美國與歐洲安全非常重要的地點。

paragraphs.en: Washington signed a security agreement this year with the leaders of Greenland, which is an autonomous territory of Denmark. The US will build two military bases in southern and eastern Greenland.
paragraphs.zh: 華盛頓今年與格陵蘭的領導人簽署了一項安全協議，格陵蘭是丹麥的自治領地。美國將在格陵蘭南部和東部建立兩個軍事基地。

paragraphs.en: Greenland lies on the shortest missile route between Russia and the US, making it vital for the planned defense shield. Trump noted that the amount of easily available oil there is huge.
paragraphs.zh: 格陵蘭位於俄羅斯和美國之間最短的飛彈航線上，這使它對計畫中的防禦盾牌至關重要。川普指出，那裡容易取得的石油數量極為龐大。

paragraphs.en: In separate news, the Coast Guard Administration (CGA) of Taiwan sent two vessels on a diplomatic visit to Palau, reaching the southernmost deployment record for a coast guard ship. Meanwhile, the military plans to receive Stinger missiles from the US to help defend Taiwan proper and outlying islands.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他新聞方面，臺灣的海巡署（CGA）派遣兩艘船隻對帛琉進行外交訪問，創下了海巡艦艇最南方部署的紀錄。同時，軍方計畫接收來自美國的刺針飛彈，以協助防衛臺灣本島及外島。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, Taiwan is closely watching online rumors about a pneumonic plague outbreak spreading from Russia into China, while the European Parliament adopted a recommendation that rejects China's efforts to restrict Taiwan's international participation.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，臺灣正密切關注關於鼠疫疫情從俄羅斯傳播到中國的網路謠言，而歐洲議會則通過了一項建議案，拒絕中國限制臺灣國際參與的企圖。

grammar.explain: 使用關代「which」引導子句來補充說明格陵蘭島的自治地位。
grammar.example: Washington signed a security agreement this year with the leaders of Greenland, which is an autonomous territory of Denmark.
grammar.focus: which is an autonomous territory of Denmark

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞「making」引導分詞構句，表達地理位置所造成的結果。
grammar.example: Greenland lies on the shortest missile route between Russia and the US, making it vital for the planned defense shield.
grammar.focus: making it vital for the planned defense shield

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞「to help」來表達接收飛彈的目的。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, the military plans to receive Stinger missiles from the US to help defend Taiwan proper and outlying islands.
grammar.focus: to help defend Taiwan proper and outlying islands

lessons.title: Dog that hunts invasive 'sea vomit' honoured as animal of the year
lessons.title_zh: 獵捕外來種「海洋嘔吐物」的狗狗獲頒年度動物獎

paragraphs.en: A black Labrador named Sgiath from the Scottish Highlands has won the animal of the year award from a charity. The International Fund for Animal Welfare is giving this honor to the dog at its annual event on Thursday 15 October.
paragraphs.zh: 來自蘇格蘭高地的一隻名叫 Sgiath 的黑色拉布拉多犬贏得了某個慈善機構頒發的年度動物獎。國際愛護動物基金會（International Fund for Animal Welfare）將於 10 月 15 日星期四在其年度活動中將此殊榮頒發給這隻狗狗。

paragraphs.en: Sgiath works with her owner, marine ecologist Dr Texa Sim, to track down a harmful marine creature known as the carpet sea squirt. This organism is also nicknamed sea vomit and can smother native wildlife if left uncontrolled.
paragraphs.zh: Sgiath 與她的主人、海洋生態學家 Texa Sim 博士一同工作，追蹤一種被稱為地毯海鞘的有害海洋生物。這種生物也被綽號為海洋嘔吐物，如果任由其不受控制，會使本土野生動物窒息死亡。

paragraphs.en: Believed to be the first sea squirt-hunting dog in the UK, the six-year-old animal was originally trained as a mountain rescue dog. Sim wondered if those scent detection skills could help with marine conservation work.
paragraphs.zh: 這隻六歲的動物被認為是英國第一隻獵捕海鞘的狗，原本受過訓練成為一隻山地救援犬。Sim 想知道這些氣味偵測技能是否能用於海洋保育工作。

paragraphs.en: The dog was trained to recognize the specific scent and now joins her owner on beaches during low tide. Sim says the dog can pinpoint exactly where the sea squirt is hiding among seaweed and structures.
paragraphs.zh: 這隻狗受過訓練能夠識別特定氣味，現在會在退潮時與主人一起去海灘。Sim 表示，這隻狗可以精確指出海藻和構造物當中海鞘隱藏的位置。

paragraphs.en: Experts explain that the carpet sea squirt originally came from Japan and arrived in England and Wales in 2008. These invasive species can outcompete native wildlife for nutrients and clog machinery, costing millions of pounds across Europe every year.
paragraphs.zh: 專家解釋，地毯海鞘最初來自日本，並於 2008 年抵達英格蘭和威爾斯。這些外來物種會為了養分而競爭贏過本土野生動物並堵塞機械，每年在歐洲各地花費數百萬英鎊。

grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，句型為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: A black Labrador named Sgiath from the Scottish Highlands has won the animal of the year award from a charity.

grammar.explain: 使用 which 來修飾前方的名詞 marine creature，補充說明其背景。
grammar.example: Sgiath works with her owner, marine ecologist Dr Texa Sim, to track down a harmful marine creature known as the carpet sea squirt.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 加原形動詞來表達做出某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: The dog was trained to recognize the specific scent and now joins her owner on beaches during low tide.

lessons.title: India and China aren't friends - but Nepal wants to unite them against climate threats
lessons.title_zh: 印度與中國不是朋友——但尼泊爾希望團結兩國來對抗氣候威脅

paragraphs.en: Nepal recently proposed bringing together regional rivals India and China to tackle shared climate threats in the Himalayas. During the United Nations General Assembly, Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah warned about the growing danger of climate disasters, such as the debris floods that struck his nation in August. He suggested creating a new mechanism to improve cross-border disaster response and data sharing in this sensitive area.
paragraphs.zh: 尼泊爾最近提議將區域對手印度與中國聚集在一起，以應對喜馬拉雅山脈共同面臨的氣候威脅。在聯合國大會期間，尼泊爾總理巴倫德拉·沙阿警告氣候災害日益嚴重的危險，例如八月侵襲他國家的泥石流洪水。他建議建立一個新機制，以改善這個敏感地區的跨國災害應對與資料分享。

paragraphs.en: The Himalayas face a severe climate threat because temperatures there are rising faster than the global average. This rapid warming causes glaciers to melt quickly and permafrost to thaw, leading to higher risks of landslides, avalanches, and glacial lake floods. These disasters can easily cross national borders, threatening people and property far downstream.
paragraphs.zh: 喜馬拉雅山脈面臨嚴重的氣候威脅，因為當地的氣溫上升速度比全球平均更快。這種快速暖化導致冰川迅速融化並使永久凍土解凍，進而導致山崩、雪崩以及冰川湖洪水的風險增加。這些災害很容易跨越國界，威脅下游遠處的人民與財產。

paragraphs.en: Although India and China share a long, disputed frontier and have experienced military stand-offs, they also share an urgent environmental crisis. Studies show that glaciers in the region are shrinking rapidly, while the number of dangerous glacial lakes is increasing. Past efforts by the two Asian powers to work together on these issues have made little progress, and some previous data-sharing agreements have already expired.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管印度與中國共用一條漫長且有爭議的邊界，並經歷過軍事對峙，他們也面臨著共同的急迫環境危機。研究顯示，該地區的冰川正在迅速縮減，危險冰川湖的數量則在增加。這兩個亞洲強權過去在這些議題上合作的努力進展甚微，且先前的一些資料分享協議已經失效。

paragraphs.en: Experts note that sharing essential climate data remains difficult because information needed by scientists can also have military value. While some analysts believe recent diplomatic thaws might create room for future co-operation, Beijing is likely to remain cautious about any major agreement. Nepal now faces the challenge of convincing its two powerful neighbors to put aside their differences for the sake of survival.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，分享重要的氣候資料仍然困難，因為科學家所需的資訊也可能具有軍事價值。雖然一些分析師認為最近的外交融冰可能會為未來的合作創造空間，但北京對於任何重大協議很可能仍會保持謹慎。尼泊爾現在面臨的挑戰，是說服其兩個強大的鄰國為了生存而放下彼此的分歧。

grammar.explain: 用來引導形容詞子句，修飾先行詞 disaster。
grammar.example: During the United Nations General Assembly, Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah warned about the growing danger of climate disasters, such as the debris floods that struck his nation in August.
grammar.focus: that struck his nation in August

grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: Studies show that glaciers in the region are shrinking rapidly, while the number of dangerous glacial lakes is increasing.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞片語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表示某個動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: Nepal now faces the challenge of convincing its two powerful neighbors to put aside their differences for the sake of survival.

lessons.title: For the future of green politics, look beyond the Green party | Zoe Williams
lessons.title_zh: 為了綠色政治的未來，請跳脫綠黨的思考框架

paragraphs.en: Climate politics recently faced a significant challenge in the United Kingdom when a Reform UK councillor attempted to scrap a climate emergency declaration in King’s Lynn and West Norfolk. Although the motion was eventually voted down, similar debates are happening across the country. Some populist politicians continue to argue that reducing carbon emissions is too expensive or unnecessary. They claim that net zero goals are merely a luxury belief held by a comfortable elite who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people.
paragraphs.zh: 氣候政治最近在英國面臨了一項重大挑戰，當時一位英國改革黨（Reform UK）的市議員試圖在金斯林與西諾福克（King’s Lynn and West Norfolk）廢除氣候緊急狀態宣言。儘管該動議最終遭到否決，類似的辯論仍在全國各地上演。一些民粹主義政治人物持續主張，減少碳排放過於昂貴或不必要。他們宣稱，淨零目標只不過是安逸菁英階層所持有的奢侈信仰，這些人忽視了普通百姓的日常掙扎。

paragraphs.en: Many people across the UK actually want action on climate change, but turning this strong public feeling into concrete political progress remains difficult. Rightwing populists exploit economic anxieties, such as the rising cost of living, to build support for their views. They frame climate policies as an unfair burden on the masses. When governments fail to address these deep financial worries, they inadvertently strengthen the appeal of populist arguments, leaving many citizens feeling hopeless about the future.
paragraphs.zh: 英國許多民眾實際上希望採取行動應對氣候變遷，但要將這種強烈的公眾感受轉化為具體的政治進展仍然很困難。右翼民粹主義者利用經濟焦慮（例如不斷上升的生活成本）來為他們的觀點建立支持。他們將氣候政策描繪成對大眾的不公負擔。當政府未能解決這些深層的財務擔憂時，他們無意間強化了民粹主義論點的吸引力，讓許多公民對未來感到絕望。

paragraphs.en: To counter this trend, green politicians like Caroline Lucas and philosopher Rupert Read propose a strategy called eco-popularism. This approach focuses on promoting practical actions that genuinely improve people's lives rather than relying purely on emotional appeals or abstract global warnings. By demonstrating how green policies can lower energy costs and build community resilience, leaders can counter the misleading narratives spread by populists and inspire genuine public support.
paragraphs.zh: 為了對抗這種趨勢，像卡羅琳·盧卡斯（Caroline Lucas）這樣的綠黨政治人物與哲學家魯珀特·里德（Rupert Read）提出了一項名為「生態大眾主義」（eco-popularism）的策略。這種方法著重於推動能真正改善人民生活的實際行動，而不是純粹依賴情感訴求或抽象的全球警告。透過展示綠色政策如何降低能源成本並建立社區韌性，領導人可以反擊民粹主義者散播的誤導性敘事，並激發真正的公眾支持。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, defeating climate skepticism requires local unity and clear communication from all political parties. Leaders must show that they have a reliable plan for cheaper energy, food security, and extreme weather events. If mainstream politicians fail to offer a hopeful and coherent alternative, they will continue to lose ground to opponents who offer simple but destructive answers to complex global problems.
paragraphs.zh: 最終，擊敗氣候懷疑論需要所有政黨的地方團結與清晰溝通。領導人必須證明他們針對更便宜的能源、糧食安全以及極端氣候事件制定了可靠的計畫。如果主流政治人物無法提供充滿希望且一致的替代方案，他們將繼續在面對複雜全球問題時，將陣地輸給那些提供簡單卻具破壞性答案的對手。

grammar.explain: 用所引導的子句來修飾先行詞，補充說明普通百姓的處境。
grammar.example: They claim that net zero goals are merely a luxury belief held by a comfortable elite who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people.
grammar.focus: who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people

grammar.explain: 使用 be 動詞加上過去分詞來強調動作的承受者，此處指動議被投票否決。
grammar.example: Although the motion was eventually voted down, similar debates are happening across the country.

lessons.title: Plan unveiled to increase share of land farmed organically in England to 10%
lessons.title_zh: 英格蘭公布計畫 目標在二〇三六年將有機耕地比例提升至百分之十

paragraphs.en: The government in England has announced a new goal to increase the share of agricultural land farmed organically to 10% by the year 2036. At present, only 3.4% of the nation's farmland is managed in this way, which is one of the lowest proportions in Europe. In contrast, France already uses organic methods on 10.4% of its land and plans to reach 18% by 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 英格蘭政府已宣布一項新目標，計畫在西元二〇三六年將以有機方式耕作的農地比例提升至百分之十。目前該國僅有百分之三點四的農地以有機方式經營，是歐洲比例最低的國家之一。相較之下，法國的國土已有百分之十點四採用有機農法，並計畫在二〇二七年達到百分之十八。

paragraphs.en: Rob Haward, the chief executive of the organic vegetable box company Riverford, noted that this situation shows how organic farming receives strong political backing in the European Union. He pointed out that the last official strategy in England was released over twenty years ago. The newly revealed plan has been developed over three years and views public procurement, such as food for schools and hospitals, as a major opportunity for growth.
paragraphs.zh: 有機蔬菜箱公司Riverford的執行長羅伯·霍華德（Rob Haward）指出，這種情況顯示了有機農業在歐盟如何獲得強大的政治支持。他指出，英格蘭上一份官方策略是在二十多年前發布的。新公布的計畫經過三年多的籌備，並將公共採購（例如學校和醫院的伙食）視為成長的主要機會。

paragraphs.en: The environment secretary, Angela Eagle, stated that the plan is about opening up opportunities and should not be treated as a niche. However, critics like Haward warn that public procurement remains very difficult for small farms to access without proper government backing, such as grant funding. Thousands of farmers previously faced disappointment when a sustainable farming incentive fund ran out of money in just six hours.
paragraphs.zh: 環境大臣安琪拉·伊格爾（Angela Eagle）表示，該計畫旨在開創機會，且不應被視為小眾市場。然而，像霍華德這樣的批評者警告說，若沒有適當的政府支持（例如補助資金），小農要參與公共採購依然非常困難。先前，當永續農業獎勵基金在短短六小時內就被用完時，數千名農民感到十分失望。

paragraphs.en: Gareth Morgan from the Soil Association explained that an urgent reopening of funding schemes is necessary to help farms make the transition. He also mentioned that as organic food becomes more mainstream, consumer prices could decrease. Furthermore, Martin Lines from the Nature Friendly Farming Network emphasized that private sector investment and fair prices for domestic goods are equally vital for the success of this agricultural shift.
paragraphs.zh: 來自土壤協會（Soil Association）的蓋瑞特·摩根（Gareth Morgan）解釋說，必須緊急重新開放資助計畫，以幫助農場完成轉型。他也提到，隨著有機食品變得更主流，消費者價格可能會下降。此外，來自自然友善農業網路（Nature Friendly Farming Network）的馬丁·萊ines（Martin Lines）強調，私部門投資以及對本土商品給予公平的價格，對於這次農業轉型的成功同樣至關重要。

paragraphs.en: Supporters including the National Farmers’ Union believe the plan is a positive step that will strengthen food supply chains and reduce reliance on imports. Proponents also highlight that organic farms prove to be more resilient during extreme weather events like heat and drought, while remaining unaffected by soaring fertiliser costs linked to international conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 包括全國農場主聯合會（National Farmers' Union）在內的支持者認為，該計畫是一個積極的步驟，將鞏固糧食供應鏈並減少對進口的依賴。支持者亦強調，事實證明有機農場在熱浪和乾旱等極端天氣事件中更具韌性，同時也不受與國際衝突相關的飆升肥料成本所影響。

grammar.explain: 用關代 which 引導形容詞子句，用來補充說明前面提過的整件事。
grammar.example: At present, only 3.4% of the nation's farmland is managed in this way, which is one of the lowest proportions in Europe.
grammar.focus: which is one of the lowest proportions in Europe

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial Clause of Cause)
grammar.explain: 用連接詞 as 引導副詞子句，說明動作發生的原因。
grammar.example: He also mentioned that as organic food becomes more mainstream, consumer prices could decrease.
grammar.focus: as organic food becomes more mainstream

lessons.title: Mont Blanc, the ‘roof of Europe’, loses more than a metre of height in a year
lessons.title_zh: 白朗峰，「歐洲屋脊」，一年內高度減少超過一公尺

paragraphs.en: Western Europe's highest mountain has shrunk by more than a metre over the past year. Surveyors announced on Wednesday that the peak of Mont Blanc in France now reaches four thousand, eight hundred and seven meters above sea level, making the roof of Europe nearly one point three meters lower than it was previously.
paragraphs.zh: 西歐最高峰在過去一年中縮減了超過一公尺。測量人員於週三宣布，位於法國的白朗峰峰頂目前海拔高度達到四千八百零七公尺，這使得這座歐洲屋脊比先前降低了將近一點三公尺。

paragraphs.en: The mountain is continuously shifting because heat, wind, and rain change the amount of snow and ice resting on top. When experts measured the summit during a recent expedition, they found it was higher than the record-low levels seen two years ago, yet it remains far below its peak measurement from two thousand and seven.
paragraphs.zh: 由於熱氣、風力以及雨水改變了山頂上的積雪與冰層厚度，這座山脈不斷地在變動。當專家在最近的一次遠征中測量山頂時，發現它比兩年前創下的歷史最低點還要高，但它仍然遠低於二○○七年的最高測量紀錄。

paragraphs.en: Specialist surveyors from two national organizations used advanced satellite technology along with flying drones to create a thorough model of the snowy cap. They have regularly monitored the peak since two thousand and one, and their gathered information shows clear evidence of change over the decades.
paragraphs.zh: 來自兩個國家組織的專業測量人員運用先進的衛星技術搭配飛行無人機，建立了一個詳細的雪冠模型。他們自二○○一年起定期監測這座山峰，而他們所收集的資料顯示出數十年來的明顯變動證據。

paragraphs.en: However, scientists warned the public against connecting these yearly altitude fluctuations directly to the fast disappearance of Alpine ice caused by pollution. A spokesperson explained that changes in surface altitude are quite different from shifts in total ice volume, noting that a higher summit does not prove the mountain has added frozen mass.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，科學家警告大眾，切勿將這些年度高度波動直接與汙染所導致的阿爾卑斯冰層快速消失劃上等號。一位發言人解釋，地表高度的變化與冰塊總體積的轉變截然不同，並指出較高的山峰並不證明該山已經增加了結冰質量。

paragraphs.en: Although experts advised caution with yearly mountain measurements, climate breakdown clearly influenced the region during the unusually hot summer months. Glaciologists recently issued warnings after confirming significant ice losses across the country over the past five years, showing that warming trends remain visible in lower Alpine areas.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管專家建議對每年的山脈測量保持謹慎，但氣候崩潰在異常炎熱的夏季月份中明顯影響了該地區。冰川學家最近在證實過去五年全國各地出現顯著冰層流失後發出了警告，顯示暖化趨勢在較低的阿爾卑斯山區依然清晰可見。

grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 mountain 的性質，補充說明其高度變化。
grammar.example: Western Europe's highest mountain has shrunk by more than a metre over the past year.

grammar.explain: 強調冰層由汙染所導致的消失狀況。
grammar.example: However, scientists warned the public against connecting these yearly altitude fluctuations directly to the fast disappearance of Alpine ice caused by pollution.

lessons.title: Burnham - Rosebank and Jackdaw oil and gas decisions coming 'shortly'
lessons.title_zh: 首相：羅osebank與Jackdaw油氣田開發決定即將出爐

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced that the government will soon decide whether to approve two major oil and gas fields in the North Sea. These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.
paragraphs.zh: 首相安迪·伯恩罕宣布，政府將很快決定是否批准北海的兩個大型油氣田。這些備受爭議的計畫被稱為Rosebank與Jackdaw，在過去幾年中引發了產業界與環保人士之間的激烈辯論。

paragraphs.en: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch criticized the prime minister for delaying the process and urged him to take action immediately. She argued that approving these projects earlier could have provided British gas to warm homes during the winter. In response, Burnham explained that his administration had to fix previous legal problems left by the former government.
paragraphs.zh: 保守黨領袖凱米·巴德諾批評首相拖延流程並敦促他立即採取行動。她主張早日批准這些計畫本可以在冬季提供英國天然氣來為家庭取暖。作為回應，伯恩罕解釋說，他的政府必須修復前政府留下的先前法律問題。

paragraphs.en: Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh stated that all necessary information regarding the Jackdaw gas field has been thoroughly reviewed, making an official choice imminent. Meanwhile, the assessment for the Rosebank oil and gas field requires a bit more time before a final verdict is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 能源大臣米亞塔·法恩布利表示，關於Jackdaw天然氣田的所有必要資訊都已經過徹底審查，這意味著官方抉擇即將到來。同時，針對Rosebank油氣田的評估在做出最終裁決之前還需要多一點時間。

paragraphs.en: The legal troubles surrounding these sites began when the Court of Session in Edinburgh ruled that previous approvals were unlawful. The court pointed out that the former government failed to consider the climate impacts of burning the extracted fossil fuels. Environmentalists strongly oppose the drilling because it hampers emission reduction goals, whereas industry supporters claim it is vital for national energy security and jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 圍繞這些場址的法律麻煩始於愛丁堡的最高民事法院裁定先前的批准不合法。法院指出，前政府未能考慮燃燒開採出的化石燃料所帶來的氣候影響。環保人士強烈反對鑽探，因為它妨礙了減排目標，而業界支持者則聲稱這對國家能源安全與就業至關重要。

grammar.explain: 當句子的主語是動作的接受者時，使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達被動語態。
grammar.example: These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.

grammar.explain: 用來表示過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響，或持續到現在的狀態，結構為「have/has + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: These controversial projects, known as Rosebank and Jackdaw, have sparked intense debates between industry groups and environmental activists over the past few years.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」置於句中或句尾，用來表達某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: She argued that approving these projects earlier could have provided British gas to warm homes during the winter.

lessons.title: Hands-on with the Ocarina of Time remake, the most ornate Zelda game ever made
lessons.title_zh: 實測《時之笛》重製版：史上最華麗的薩爾達傳說遊戲

paragraphs.en: Following the huge success of several movie projects, Nintendo is preparing to bring The Legend of Zelda to the big screen next April. To keep the franchise popular, the company is lavishly remaking its classic 1998 video game, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The title is scheduled to debut on November fifth.
paragraphs.zh: 繼幾個電影計畫獲得巨大成功之後，任天堂（Nintendo）準備在明年四月將《薩爾達傳說》（The Legend of Zelda）搬上大銀幕。為了維持這個系列的熱度，該公司正砸重金重製其 1998 年的經典電玩遊戲《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》（The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time）。該作品預定於 11 月 5 日正式登場。

paragraphs.en: The new version stands out by offering a family-friendly fantasy world, arriving just two weeks before the massive release of Grand Theft Auto VI. While the competition features extreme realism and violent themes, the Zelda remake maintains the cartoony aesthetic of the original game while adding incredible detail. Characters wear hand-stitched fabrics and leathers, and creatures feature complex textures.
paragraphs.zh: 新版本透過提供老少咸宜的奇幻世界脫穎而出，並在《俠盜獵車手 VI》（Grand Theft Auto VI）大型發行前兩週推出。雖然競爭對手主打極致的寫實主義與暴力主題，但這款薩爾達重製版在加入不可思議細節的同時，仍保留了原作卡通化的美學。角色穿著手工縫製的織物與皮革，生物則呈現出複雜的質感。

paragraphs.en: During a preview event, a player explored areas like Kokiri Forest and Hyrule Field, noting that clever lighting makes the world feel surprisingly vast. Castle Town also appears much busier, filled with banners and flowers. However, the rich visual details can sometimes overwhelm the eye, making it slightly difficult to navigate through complex dungeons without missing important items.
paragraphs.zh: 在預覽活動期間，一名玩家探索了科奇利森林（Kokiri Forest）與海拉爾平原（Hyrule Field）等區域，並指出巧妙的燈光讓世界感覺大得驚人。城堡鎮（Castle Town）也顯得更加熱鬧，充滿了旗幟與花朵。然而，豐富的視覺細節有時會讓人應接不暇，在沒有漏掉重要道具的情況下，要穿越複雜的地城會變得稍微困難。

paragraphs.en: Regarding mechanical updates, Nintendo kept changes relatively modest. The developer added a user interface similar to recent series entries and introduced a quest log in the menu. Furthermore, players can now use a manual jump and a button to sprint, which helps them move quickly across the linear adventure without constantly rolling around.
paragraphs.zh: 在機制更新方面，任天堂保持了相對保守的做法。開發商加入了類似近期系列作品的使用者介面，並在選單中引入了任務日誌。此外，玩家現在可以使用手動跳躍以及衝刺按鈕，這有助於他們在這趟線性冒險中快速移動，而不必一直翻滾。

paragraphs.en: With the movie debut approaching, this remake is seen as a smart choice to attract both longtime fans and new players. The high production values reflect Nintendo's new priority of giving careful attention to both animation and gameplay, though players will need more than a short session to fully judge the deep quality of the experience.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著電影上映日期的逼近，這款重製版被視為吸引老粉絲與新玩家的明智選擇。高製作水準反映了任天堂的新優先事項，也就是對動畫與遊戲玩法都給予細心的關注，儘管玩家需要超過一場短暫的體驗才能完全評判其深層品質。

grammar.explain: 說明用來修飾前方名詞「items」的形容詞子句結構。
grammar.example: making it slightly difficult to navigate through complex dungeons without missing important items.

grammar.explain: 說明由逗號隔開、沒有連接詞且以現在分詞開頭的附帶狀況子句。
grammar.example: Castle Town also appears much busier, filled with banners and flowers.

lessons.title: Defiance or denial? Inside Manchester City’s bubble, decked with inflatable bananas
lessons.title_zh: 反叛還是否認？曼城泡泡裡充斥著充氣香蕉

paragraphs.en: Manchester City recently played against Paris Saint-Germain at the Etihad Stadium while facing major controversy. The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism. However, the club continues to maintain its innocence and insists it is the victim of unfair treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 曼徹斯特城足球俱樂部最近在伊蒂哈德球場對陣巴黎聖日耳曼，同時面臨重大爭議。這家英格蘭超級聯賽俱樂部被判定違反了一百多項財務規定，並受到嚴厲批評。然而，該俱樂部繼續堅稱自己清白，並堅持認為自己是不公平對待的受害者。

paragraphs.en: Inside the stadium, the atmosphere felt entirely detached from the external trouble. Manager Enzo Maresca and the players have publicly stayed united behind the club ownership. Supporters also embraced their new reputation as villains, filling the stands with optimism and hundreds of yellow inflatable bananas as a historical callback to the 1980s.
paragraphs.zh: 在球場內，這種氣氛讓人感覺完全脫離了外部的麻煩。總教練恩佐·馬雷斯卡和球員們公開團結在俱樂部所有權背後。支持者也接受了他們作為反派的新形象，用樂觀情緒和數百個黃色充氣香蕉填滿了看台，作為對1980年代歷史的回顧。

paragraphs.en: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties. Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity. Despite a four to two defeat, the club and its fans maintained a cheerful appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 比賽期間，巴黎聖日耳曼得到了他們的總教練路易斯·恩rique的支持，他表達了希望曼徹斯特城能避免嚴厲處罰的願望。同時，前總教練佩普·瓜迪奧拉重返球場，對團結表現出強烈支持。儘管以四比二落敗，該俱樂部及其球迷仍保持著歡快的表象。

paragraphs.en: Once people step outside the stadium, reality quickly returns. Fans mostly refuse to discuss the legal charges and simply tell reporters to wait for the appeal. Experts note that as long as the appeal process continues, the club will continue to face serious tests during every upcoming league match.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦人們走出球場，現實很快就會回歸。球迷大多拒絕討論法律指控，只是告訴記者等待上訴。專家指出，只要上訴程序繼續進行，該俱樂部將在每一場即將到來的聯賽中繼續面臨嚴峻考驗。

grammar.explain: 此句使用被動語態「has been found」來表達俱樂部被判定違規的事實，強調受動者。
grammar.example: The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism.

grammar.explain: 此句使用關係代名詞「who」引導形容詞子句，用來修飾巴黎聖日耳曼的總教練路易斯·恩rique。
grammar.example: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties.
grammar.focus: who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此句使用不定詞片語「to show strong support for unity」來表達前總教練重返球場的目的。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity.
grammar.focus: to show strong support for unity

lessons.title: OpenAI accuses former employee of leaking intel on AI device to Apple
lessons.title_zh: OpenAI指控前員工洩漏AI設備機密給蘋果

paragraphs.en: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple. According to a court document filed on Wednesday, the individual worked briefly for OpenAI for six months after leaving Apple, and then returned to Apple.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧公司OpenAI指控一名未具名的前員工，竊取有關一款尚未發布之裝置的敏感智慧財產權，並將部分細節分享給蘋果（Apple）。根據週三提交的一份法院文件，該名個人在離開蘋果後，曾在OpenAI短暫工作了六個月，隨後又返回蘋果任職。

paragraphs.en: The filing states that the worker downloaded over one hundred highly confidential files to personal storage before going back to Apple. These transferred documents allegedly included detailed pictures of the upcoming hardware along with secret engineering and manufacturing information. The final download reportedly happened in June on the worker's last day at the company.
paragraphs.zh: 該文件指出，該名員工在返回蘋果之前，將一百多份高度機密檔案下載到個人儲存空間中。據稱這些被轉移的文件包含了即將推出的硬體之詳細圖片，以及機密的工程與製造資訊。據報導，最後一次下載發生在六月份該員工在該公司的最後一天。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI further claimed that this former employee made a presentation regarding product plans to senior leaders at Apple, including an Asian operations vice president. The filing suggests that Apple is now using this gathered knowledge to push forward into the market for smart products powered by artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI進一步聲稱，這名前員工曾向蘋果的高階主管們（包含一位亞洲營運副總裁）進行有關產品計畫的簡報。該文件暗示，蘋果現在正利用這些收集到的知識，大力推動進入由人工智慧驅動的智慧產品市場。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Apple told CNN that it found no evidence supporting these claims and follows strict rules to prevent new hires from using past confidential materials. Apple also mentioned it would cooperate with OpenAI to remove any found information from its systems. Furthermore, Apple stated that the accusations are simply an attempt to create a distraction from an ongoing legal case brought by Apple in July.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，蘋果告訴美國有線電視新聞網（CNN），他們未發現任何證據來支持這些指控，並且遵守嚴格的規定以防止新進員工使用過去的機密資料。蘋果也提到，將會與OpenAI合作，從其系統中移除任何被發現的資訊。此外，蘋果表示這些指控純粹是試圖轉移焦點，以掩飾蘋果在七月所提起的一起進行中的法律訴訟。

paragraphs.en: In that previous lawsuit, Apple claimed that former staff members who moved to OpenAI downloaded confidential files and encouraged candidates to bring parts to job interviews. OpenAI denied those earlier claims, stating that Apple failed to identify any stolen trade secrets and tried to have the case dismissed. Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.
paragraphs.zh: 在該起先前的訴訟中，蘋果聲稱跳槽至OpenAI的前員工下載了機密檔案，並鼓勵應徵者將零件帶到工作面試中。OpenAI否認了那些早期的指控，表示蘋果未能識別出任何被竊取的營業秘密，並試圖駁回此案。兩大科技巨頭目前正激烈競合作開發新的智慧裝置，同時矽谷也持續看到工程師在公司之間流動的高比率。

grammar.explain: 用來表示過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或持續的狀態。
grammar.example: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple.

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用 V-ing 修飾前面的名詞，表達主動或進行的概念。
grammar.example: Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.

lessons.title: The fight between the SEC and LSU isn’t over and the Tigers still could be kicked out of the conference
lessons.title_zh: SEC與LSU之間的爭鬥尚未結束，這支老虎隊仍有可能被踢出聯盟

paragraphs.en: The Southeastern Conference (SEC) has filed a response in a federal lawsuit against Louisiana State University (LSU) to keep a legal dispute alive. The league claims that the university continues to break professional rules by trying to add players with professional draft backgrounds to its roster.
paragraphs.zh: 東南聯盟（SEC）已針對對路易斯安那州立大學（LSU）提起的聯邦訴訟提交回應，以維持此法律爭端。該聯盟宣稱，該大學持續透過試圖將具備職業選秀背景的球員納入名單來違反職業規則。

paragraphs.en: This conflict started when LSU men's basketball coach Will Wade recruited players who had professional basketball involvement. This action is in direct conflict with the conference policy which states that athletes who have declared for professional drafts without properly withdrawing cannot compete.
paragraphs.zh: 此衝突始於LSU男子籃球隊教練威爾·韋德（Will Wade）招募了曾參與職業籃球的球員。此舉直接與聯盟政策衝突，該政策規定曾宣佈參加職業選秀且未正確退出的運動員不得參賽。

paragraphs.en: The players involved include R.J. Luis, Saliou Niang, and Brice Dessert, who have experienced different degrees of NBA participation. Although Luis signed professional contracts, he won a court injunction to play, but the coach later stated that Luis was not on the roster and the school would follow conference protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 涉事的球員包含R.J. 路易斯（R.J. Luis）、薩利烏·尼安（Saliou Niang）及布里斯·德塞特（Brice Dessert），他們都有過不同程度的NBA參與經歷。儘管路易斯簽過職業合約並贏得法院禁令得以出賽，但教練隨後表示路易斯並未列入名單，且學校將遵循聯盟規範。

paragraphs.en: However, the coach feels positive about other players such as Niang, who was drafted and played in Summer League games. SEC commissioner Greg Sankey has avoided commenting directly on these individual players, stating that they will let the legal filing speak for itself.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，該教練對其他球員感到樂觀，例如曾在選秀會中被選中並打過夏季聯賽的尼安。SEC主席格雷格·桑基（Greg Sankey）則避免直接評論這些個別球員，表示將讓法律文件說明一切。

paragraphs.en: Although expelling the school is unlikely because the university is a major source of revenue, the league recently approved a strict discipline policy for schools that roster professional players. The penalties could include a half-season suspension for a coach and severe fines.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管將該校除名不太可能，因為該大學是主要的營收來源，但聯盟最近批准了一項針對將職業球員列入名單學校的嚴格紀律政策。處罰可能包含教練半季禁賽以及重罰。

grammar.explain: 用來表示主詞接受動作的狀態，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞 drafted。
grammar.example: However, the coach feels positive about other players such as Niang, who was drafted and played in Summer League games.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達做出某個動作的目的，在此說明學校持續這樣做的意圖。
grammar.example: The league claims that the university continues to break professional rules by trying to add players with professional draft backgrounds to its roster.

lessons.title: World’s oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
lessons.title_zh: 土耳其海岸外發現世界上最古老的沉船

paragraphs.en: Archaeologists exploring the waters off the southern coast of Turkey have discovered an ancient shipwreck. The vessel dates back roughly 4,700 years, which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world. According to an official statement from Turkey's culture ministry, the wreck lies at a depth of about 100 feet near Kekova Island.
paragraphs.zh: 在土耳其南部海岸外水域進行探勘的考古學家發現了一艘古代沉船。這艘船的歷史大約可追溯至4,700年前，使其成為世界上已知最古老的沉船。根據土耳其文化部發布的官方聲明，這處殘骸位於凱科瓦島（Kekova Island）附近約100英尺深的水下。

paragraphs.en: During the underwater excavations, researchers brought up several ancient storage jars called amphorae. These clay containers, created between 4,400 and 4,700 years ago, offer valuable clues about ancient seafaring life and commercial routes. While sailors primarily used such vessels to carry wine or olive oil, one particular container has special markings and two holes. Experts believe this unique pot might have served to make cheese or butter, suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products.
paragraphs.zh: 在水下挖掘過程中，研究人員打撈起數個被稱為雙耳細頸瓶（amphorae）的古代儲藏罐。這些製於4,400至4,700年前的陶製容器，為古代航海生活和商業路線提供了寶貴的線索。雖然水手主要使用這類容器來運送葡萄酒或橄欖油，但其中一個容器具有特殊的標記和兩個孔洞。專家認為這個獨特的罐子可能曾被用來製作乳酪或奶油，這顯示水手或許曾在船上飼養活山羊以獲取新鮮乳製品。

paragraphs.en: Professor Hakan Öniz from Akdeniz University first found the site four years ago. At that time, researchers thought the jars were from a much later period. However, Öniz noticed that they closely matched ancient jars uncovered near the Giza pyramids in Egypt. He then arranged a follow-up dive and invited Australian archaeologist Karin Sowada to inspect the site. Öniz said the team are "generally confident" that this is the world's oldest wreck, noting that discovered anchors and other items also belong to the same era.
paragraphs.zh: 來自阿克代尼茲大學（Akdeniz University）的哈坎·歐尼茲（Hakan Öniz）教授在四年前首次發現了這個遺址。當時，研究人員認為這些罐子來自更近期的時代。然而，歐尼茲注意到它們與埃及吉薩金字塔附近出土的古老罐子高度相似。隨後，他安排了一次後續潛水，並邀請澳洲考古學家卡琳·索瓦達（Karin Sowada）視察該遺址。歐尼茲表示，團隊「普遍確信」（generally confident）這是世界上最古老的沉船，並指出發現的船錨和其他文物也都屬於同一個時代。

paragraphs.en: Turkey’s culture and tourism minister, Mehmet Nuri Ersoy, revealed that tests on the clay point to workshops in the Jordan Valley as the origin of these jars. Similar pottery has appeared in Egypt, Troy, and Crete. This evidence highlights the vital sea routes that linked distant regions. Historians suspect the unfortunate ship was traveling from the Levantine coast toward Troy or Crete when it sank.
paragraphs.zh: 土耳其文化和旅遊部長穆罕默德·努里·埃爾索伊（Mehmet Nuri Ersoy）透露，對陶土的分析指出約旦河谷（Jordan Valley）的工坊是這些罐子的產地來源。類似的陶器也曾出現在埃及、特洛伊（Troy）和克里特島（Crete）。這項證據凸顯了連接遙遠地區的重要海上航線。歷史學家推測，這艘不幸的船隻在沉沒時，可能正從黎凡特海岸航行前往特洛伊或克里特島。

grammar.point: 非限定關係代名詞 (Non-defining Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的「which」作為非限定關係代名詞，用來代替前面整件事（沉船歷史可追溯至4,700年前），並引出其造成的結果。
grammar.example: The vessel dates back roughly 4,700 years, which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world.
grammar.focus: , which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world

grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞「suggesting」構成的分詞構句，省略了連接詞，用來補充說明主句所衍生出的推測或結果。
grammar.example: Experts believe this unique pot might have served to make cheese or butter, suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products.
grammar.focus: , suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 「to inspect the site」為不定詞片語，在此句中作副詞使用，用來清楚說明邀請澳洲考古學家前來的「目的」。
grammar.example: He then arranged a follow-up dive and invited Australian archaeologist Karin Sowada to inspect the site.

lessons.title: Philadelphia Eagles fans flock to the bar that brings the City of Brotherly Love to London
lessons.title_zh: 費城老鷹隊球迷湧入將「兄弟愛之城」帶到倫敦的酒吧

paragraphs.en: When JP Teti moved from South Philadelphia to London, he noticed a lack of regional American cuisine and traditional dive bars. He decided to leave his corporate job and create a unique place that served authentic local food and offered a true cultural experience.
paragraphs.zh: 當 JP Teti 從南費城搬到倫敦時，他注意到當地缺乏美國地方美食和傳統平價酒吧。他決定辭去企業工作，打造一個供應道地地方美食並提供真實文化體驗的獨特場所。

paragraphs.en: After years of selling food from a truck and perfecting recipes, Teti opened the first Passyunk Avenue in Fitzrovia in 2018. That same year, the Philadelphia Eagles won the Super Bowl and brought the trophy to the original venue, helping the business grow to five locations in London.
paragraphs.zh: 經過多年從餐車販售食物和精進食譜，Teti 於 2018 年在菲特茲羅維亞開設了第一家 Passyunk 大道酒吧。同一年，費城老鷹隊贏得超級盃並將獎盃帶到最初的店面，助推該企業在倫敦發展到五個據點。

paragraphs.en: As a large number of football fans traveled to London recently, they flocked to the bars to enjoy familiar foods like cheesesteaks and participate in events. The venues successfully created a lively atmosphere that made visitors feel completely at home.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著大量美式足球球迷最近前往倫敦，他們湧入這些酒吧享用起司牛排等熟悉的食物並參加活動。這些場所成功營造出熱鬧的氣氛，讓遊客感到完全就像在家一樣。

paragraphs.en: Reflecting on his journey, Teti expressed deep satisfaction with how his business brought people together. He noted that Passyunk Avenue now serves as an outpost of hope and cultural exchange for those who appreciate American traditions.
paragraphs.zh: 回顧自己的旅程，Teti 對他的事業如何將人們聚集在一起表達了深深的滿足感。他指出，對於那些欣賞美國傳統的人來說，Passyunk 大道現在成了希望與文化交流的前哨站。

grammar.explain: 用現在分詞片語作為附加的補充說明，省略連接詞且主詞與主要子句相同。
grammar.example: Reflecting on his journey, Teti expressed deep satisfaction with how his business brought people together.

grammar.explain: 使用 who 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾先行詞 those。
grammar.example: He noted that Passyunk Avenue now serves as an outpost of hope and cultural exchange for those who appreciate American traditions.

grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語來表達動作的目的，說明為什麼要做這個動作。
grammar.example: He decided to leave his corporate job and create a unique place that served authentic local food and offered a true cultural experience.
grammar.focus: to leave his corporate job and create a unique place

lessons.title: Look of the Week: Ayo Edebiri’s swan silhouette reimagines the bustle
lessons.title_zh: 時尚看點：艾yo·艾德比利的天鵝輪廓重新詮釋了臀墊

paragraphs.en: Award-winning actor Ayo Edebiri recently attended a film festival screening in London wearing a sophisticated outfit designed by Chanel. The look featured a simple black skirt paired with a creamy top that had a special feathery hem. Her dangling earrings matched her lipstick, while her braids were styled into an elegant updo.
paragraphs.zh: 獲獎演員艾yo·艾德比利（Ayo Edebiri）最近出席在倫敦舉行的電影節放映會，身穿香奈兒（Chanel）設計的精緻服裝。這套造型包含一件簡單的黑色長裙，搭配帶有特殊羽毛狀下擺的乳白色上衣。她那下垂的耳環與口紅相呼應，而她的小辮子則梳成了優雅的盤髮。

paragraphs.en: Even though she represents the fashion label as a brand ambassador, Edebiri always manages to keep her style looking fresh and relaxed. This specific outfit came from a recent haute couture collection that focused heavily on fairytale and nature themes. When seen from the side, the clothing reveals a swan-like shape that acts like a modern version of a traditional bustle.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管身為該時尚品牌的形象大使，艾德比利總能讓她的風格看起來清新且輕鬆。這套特定的服裝來自最近的高級訂製系列，該系列主要著重於童話和自然主題。從側面看去，這件衣服展現出天鵝般的輪廓，就像是傳統臀墊的現代版本。

paragraphs.en: This choice brings to mind a famous celebrity swan dress from the past, though this new version remains sleek and playful. Interestingly, birds also appear as important symbols in the novel "Mrs. Dalloway," which serves as the source material for Edebiri’s new movie project called "Clarissa."
paragraphs.zh: 這個選擇讓人想起過去一件著名的名人天鵝裙，雖然這個新版本保持了流線型且俏皮的風格。有趣的是，鳥類也是小說《達洛維夫人》（Mrs. Dalloway）中的重要象徵，該小說是艾德比利名為《克拉莉莎》（Clarissa）的新電影計畫的取材來源。

paragraphs.en: The new film stands out as a very stylish cinematic work due to its unique setting and careful costume design. Edebiri and her co-stars will likely continue to honor the artistic spirit of the movie through their fashion choices on many red carpets in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 這部新電影因其獨特的背景設定和細心的服裝設計，而成為一部非常時髦的電影作品。艾德比利和她的同劇演員未來很可能會在許多紅毯上，透過他們的時尚選擇繼續向該片的藝術精神致敬。

grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 which 引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的名詞短語。
grammar.example: The look featured a simple black skirt paired with a creamy top that had a special feathery hem.
grammar.focus: that had a special feathery hem

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞片語作為附加說明，表達伴隨的動作或狀態。
grammar.example: Her dangling earrings matched her lipstick, while her braids were styled into an elegant updo.

grammar.explain: 使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達主詞承受動作的狀態。
grammar.example: This specific outfit came from a recent haute couture collection that focused heavily on fairytale and nature themes.

lessons.title: Europe leads the world on AI rules. So why is it missing from the AI safety debate?
lessons.title_zh: 歐洲在人工智慧規則上領導全球。那麼為什麼它缺席了人工智慧安全辯論？

paragraphs.en: Europe has created the world's first comprehensive set of rules to govern artificial intelligence, known as the AI Act. However, the continent remains noticeably absent from high-level global talks about ensuring the safe use of this technology.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲制定了全球第一套管理人工智慧的全面規則，被稱為「人工智慧法案」（AI Act）。然而，該洲在確保這項技術安全使用的高階全球會談中，依然顯著地缺席。

paragraphs.en: French economist Philippe Aghion warned that Europe faces a high risk of marginalization on the world stage due to rapid advancements in this field. He co-wrote a report suggesting that the region urgently needs a course correction to succeed in the modern era.
paragraphs.zh: 法國經濟學家菲利普·阿吉翁（Philippe Aghion）警告說，由於該領域的快速進展，歐洲正面臨在世界舞台被邊緣化的巨大風險。他共同撰寫了一份報告，指出該地區迫切需要修正方針才能在現代時代取得成功。

paragraphs.en: Unlike Silicon Valley in the United States, Europe struggles to foster major technology giants and lacks frontier models that can match popular tools from other nations. European Central Bank president Christine Lagarde described this awkward situation as a difficult choice between holding back economic growth and becoming overly dependent on foreign technology.
paragraphs.zh: 與美國的矽谷不同，歐洲難以孕育出大型科技巨頭，且缺乏能與其他國家的熱門工具相匹敵的前沿模型。歐洲中央銀行（European Central Bank）總裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德（Christine Lagarde）將這種尷尬處境形容為在阻礙經濟增長與過度依賴外國技術之間做出艱難抉擇。

paragraphs.en: The newly established AI Act sets strict requirements for data quality and cybersecurity, allowing officials to issue massive fines for non-compliance. While leaders believe these guardrails are vital, the law has made it harder for companies to release new products quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 新建立的人工智慧法案對資料品質和網路安全設定了嚴格要求，允許官員對違規行為開出鉅額罰款。雖然領導人認為這些安全護欄至關重要，但該法律卻讓企業更難迅速推出新產品。

paragraphs.en: Surveys show that strict legal rules and unclear consequences make many local firms hesitant to adopt new systems. To ease these heavy burdens, officials have recently extended implementation timelines and watered down certain requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 調查顯示，嚴格的法律規則與不明確的後果使得許多當地企業對採用新系統感到猶豫。為了減輕這些沉重的負擔，官員們最近延長了實施時間表並放寬了某些要求。

paragraphs.en: Despite these regulatory hurdles, some experts remain hopeful about Europe's future. They point out that the continent possesses deep industrial expertise and high-quality domain data, which could ultimately create immense economic value.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在這些監管障礙，一些專家對歐洲的未來仍保持希望。他們指出，該洲擁有深厚的工業專業知識與高品質的領域資料，這最終可能會創造巨大的經濟價值。

grammar.explain: 用關代 which 引導子句來修飾前面的先行詞 tools，補充說明其來源。
grammar.example: He co-wrote a report suggesting that the region urgently needs a course correction to succeed in the modern era.

grammar.explain: 使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」結構來表示主詞 faces 承受被邊緣化的風險（此處 marginalization 為名詞，其動詞型態應用於被動概念）。
grammar.example: French economist Philippe Aghion warned that Europe faces a high risk of marginalization on the world stage due to rapid advancements in this field.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用 to 加原形動詞來表達為了成功而必須進行修正的目的。
grammar.example: He co-wrote a report suggesting that the region urgently needs a course correction to succeed in the modern era.
grammar.focus: to succeed in the modern era

lessons.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
lessons.title_zh: 這些工人正在幫助訓練有一天可能會搶走他們工作的機器人

paragraphs.en: In Karur, India, some factory workers have discovered that they are wearing smart glasses and headsets to record their daily tasks. The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs. Many employees were not informed about this purpose before wearing the devices, raising serious concerns about labor exploitation.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度卡魯爾，一些工廠工人發現自己正戴著智慧眼鏡與頭戴式裝置來記錄日常工作。他們手部動作的影片畫面被收集起來，用以訓練人工智慧機器人來接管人類的工作。許多員工在佩戴這些裝置之前並未被告知此目的，這引發了對勞動力剝削的嚴重擔憂。

paragraphs.en: India has become a major place for gathering this egocentric data because of its large population and relatively low wages. Experts explain that today's AI systems function like brains without bodies, so they need real human movements to learn intricate physical skills. While some companies pay workers by the hour for this recording process, other laborers are simply made to work while filmed without any explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 由於龐大的人口與相對低廉的薪資，印度已成為收集這種第一人稱視角資料的主要地點。專家解釋，現今的人工智慧系統運作起來就像沒有身體的大腦，因此牠們需要真實的人類動作來學習複雜的身體技能。雖然有些公司按時計費向工人支付錄製過程的費用，但其他勞工卻只是在不知情的狀況下，一邊工作一邊遭到拍攝。

paragraphs.en: Although experts envision a future full of automated machines, the deployment of such technology in India might take a long time. High costs and unreliable power supplies across parts of the country make running robots much more expensive than employing humans. Nevertheless, local tech companies continue to gather both egocentric and exocentric data for domestic and foreign clients who need help with difficult or repetitive tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管專家們預想了一個充滿自動化機器的未來，但此類技術在印度的部署可能需要很長時間。該國部分地區的高昂成本與不穩定的電力供應，使得運行機器人的花費遠高於雇用人類。然而，當地科技公司仍繼續為需要困難或重複性任務協助的國內外客戶，收集第一人稱與第三人稱視角的資料。

paragraphs.en: Inside these tech facilities, employees record themselves folding clothes, washing dishes, and sorting objects using special tools. Workers are paid a small hourly wage to repeat these domestic and industrial chores so that machines can learn various shapes and sizes. Some laborers feel that the work is tiring, but they also realize that their current tasks will eventually be done by robots.
paragraphs.zh: 在這些科技設施內部，員工使用特殊工具錄製自己摺衣服、洗碗以及分類物品的過程。工人們獲得微薄的時薪來重複這些家務與工業雜務，好讓機器能夠學習各種形狀與尺寸。有些勞工覺得這項工作很疲累，但也意識到他們目前的工作最終將由機器人來完成。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, some textile workers who wear these recording headsets have mixed feelings about the situation. One factory employee mentioned that she is proud to teach the robots how to perform quality checks and package items properly. When machines eventually replace her job in the future, she plans to switch to farming and raise cattle to support her family.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，一些佩戴這些錄影頭戴式裝置的紡織工人對這種情況有著複雜的感受。一名工廠員工提到，她為能教導機器人如何進行品質檢查與正確包裝物品感到驕傲。當機器未來最終取代她的工作時，她計劃轉行當農夫並飼養牲畜來養家糊口。

grammar.explain: 表達主體「被」收集的動作，強調承受動作的對象。
grammar.example: The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs.

grammar.point: 表目的的不定詞 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用不定詞片語來表示做某事的目的（為了訓練……）。
grammar.example: The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs.
grammar.focus: to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs

lessons.title: 'I applied for 200 jobs' - How 'spray and pray' AI job applications can backfire
lessons.title_zh: '我投了兩00份工作'——人工智慧求職的「海投」方式如何造成反效果

paragraphs.en: Many graduates are using artificial intelligence tools to help write CVs and cover letters or to find specific keywords for early-stage screening. A 22-year-old geography graduate named Tom from Maidstone applied for over two hundred jobs before securing a position as a restaurant manager last month. He described the process as exhausting and demoralising, noting that many employers fail to respond to applicants. He believes it is hypocritical for companies to discourage AI use when they employ the technology themselves to screen candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 許多畢業生正在使用人工智慧工具來協助撰寫履歷與求職信，或是找出早期篩選所需的特定關鍵字。一名來自梅德斯通、二十二歲的地理系畢業生湯姆，在獲得上個月餐廳經理的職位之前，投遞了兩百多份工作。他形容這個過程令人精疲力竭且打擊士氣，並指出許多雇主甚至不會回覆求職者。他認為，當公司自己也使用這項技術來篩選候選人時，卻勸阻求職者使用人工智慧，這是很虛偽的做法。

paragraphs.en: A survey by the Institute of Student Employers (ISE) involving one hundred fifty-five of the largest UK graduate employers found that ninety-two percent of companies encountered or suspected AI misconduct during the hiring process. This behavior often involves using AI as a real-time assistant in video interviews or online assessments. Furthermore, technology enables candidates to submit multiple applications simultaneously, a practice known in the industry as spray and pray. Stephen Isherwood from the ISE stated that this trend increases pressure on students within a highly competitive job market.
paragraphs.zh: 學生雇主協會（ISE）針對英國一百五十五家最大畢業生雇主進行的一項調查發現，百分之九十二的公司在招聘過程中遇到或懷疑有人工智慧違規行為。這種行為通常包括在視訊面試或線上評估中將人工智慧用作即時助手。此外，這項技術使求職者能夠同時提交多份申請，這種做法在業界被稱為「海投」。來自該協會的史蒂芬・伊舍伍德表示，這種趨勢增加了高度競爭的就業市場中學生的壓力。

paragraphs.en: Hollie Moody, head of early careers recruitment at the energy giant EDF, expressed understanding for graduates facing a brutal job market. However, she warned that the situation is becoming problematic. The firm recently closed its graduate recruitment scheme early after receiving twelve thousand applications, which represents a ten percent increase compared to last year. Moody explained that the widespread use of artificial intelligence has created an uneven playing field where some candidates rely on technology throughout the entire process while others do not.
paragraphs.zh: 能源巨擘EDF早期職涯招聘主管荷莉・穆迪對面臨殘酷就業市場的畢業生表示理解。然而，她警告說這個情況正在變成一個問題。該公司在收到一萬兩千份申請後，最近提前關閉了畢業生招聘計畫，這比去年增加了百分之十。穆迪解釋說，人工智慧的廣泛使用造成了一個不公平的競爭環境，有些候選人在整個過程中依賴技術，而其他人則沒有。

paragraphs.en: To combat these issues, EDF now provides clear guidance on appropriate AI usage and attempts to make its recruitment process as resistant to the technology as possible. The company examines CVs only during later stages and utilizes behavioral online assessments and video interviews to evaluate individuals. Despite these measures, some applicants still attempt to bend the rules by waiting for AI responses during interviews, resulting in identical answers that resemble reading a script. Analysts note that while the graduate job market has stabilised, it remains difficult, with each role attracting an average of one hundred forty-one applications.
paragraphs.zh: 為了解決這些問題，EDF現在針對適當使用人工智慧提供明確指導，並試圖讓其招聘過程盡可能地抵禦這項技術。該公司僅在後續階段檢視履歷，並利用行為線上評估與視訊面試來評估個人。儘管採取了這些措施，一些求職者仍試圖在面試中等待人工智慧的回應來規避規則，導致回答雷同且像是照本宣科。分析師指出，雖然畢業生就業市場已經穩定，但它仍然很艱難，每個職位平均吸引了一百四十一份申請。

grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的子句，由關係代名詞引導。
grammar.example: A survey by the Institute of Student Employers (ISE) involving one hundred fifty-five of the largest UK graduate employers found that ninety-two percent of companies encountered or suspected AI misconduct during the hiring process.
grammar.focus: that ninety-two percent of companies encountered or suspected AI misconduct during the hiring process

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用不定詞片語來表達某個動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: To combat these issues, EDF now provides clear guidance on appropriate AI usage and attempts to make its recruitment process as resistant to the technology as possible.

lessons.title: The 'frustrating' education limbo facing teenage asylum seekers
lessons.title_zh: 尋求庇護的青少年面臨「令人沮喪」的教育困境

paragraphs.en: Many teenage asylum seekers arriving in Northern Ireland face a frustrating limbo regarding their education. While the legal age for compulsory schooling ends at 16, older teenagers and young adults who flee conflict find themselves without an automatic right to enter schools or colleges.
paragraphs.zh: 許多抵達北愛爾蘭的青少年尋求庇護者在教育方面正面臨令人沮喪的困境。雖然義務教育的法定年齡止於16歲，但逃離衝突的較年長青少年和年輕成年人發現自己沒有自動進入學校或學院的權利。

paragraphs.en: Mona, a 16-year-old girl from Gaza, moved to Belfast with her family after studying online during the war. Although she initially attended school in Coleraine, she has since struggled to secure a school place and expressed stress about her future. "We are still children and we need education and support," she said, noting her goal to study nursing and return to help people in her hometown.
paragraphs.zh: 來自加薩的16歲女孩莫娜（Mona）在戰爭期間線上學習後，與家人搬到了貝爾法斯特。儘管她最初在科爾雷恩上學，但此後一直難以獲得學校名額，並對自己的未來表達了壓力。她說：「我們依然是孩子，我們需要教育和支持。」她並指出自己的目標是學習護理，並返回家鄉幫助人們。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, 19-year-old Sara came from Sudan aiming to become a doctor. However, her previous qualifications were deemed insufficient, and she had to wait a year before entering a Further Education (FE) College to study A-Levels. Both girls received assistance from the Anaka Women's Collective, a community organization supporting refugees, which has called for a specialized education program for this age group.
paragraphs.zh: 同樣地，19歲的莎拉（Sara）來自蘇當，立志成為一名醫生。然而，她先前的學歷被認為不夠充分，她不得不等待一年才能進入進修教育（FE）學院學習普通教育高級程度證書（A-Levels）。兩位女孩都得到了支援難民的社區組織阿納卡婦女集體（Anaka Women's Collective）的協助，該組織一直呼籲為這個年齡層設立專門的教育計畫。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, officials from the Department for the Economy stated that FE provision is accessible to eligible refugees aged 16 and over, noting that thousands are currently enrolled. They highlighted that free English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) courses play a key role in helping young people integrate. Yet, older students like 20-year-old Hani and 22-year-old Hossam report long waiting times for these classes, delaying their dreams of pursuing business, marketing, or fashion design.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，經濟部的官員表示，進修教育供應可供16歲及以上的合格難民使用，並指出目前已有數千人註冊。他們強調，免費的非英語母語者英語（ESOL）課程在幫助年輕人融入社會方面發揮了關鍵作用。然而，像20歲的哈妮（Hani）和22歲的霍薩姆（Hossam）這樣較年長的學生回報說，這些課程的等待時間很長，延誤了他們追求商業、行銷或時尚設計的夢想。

paragraphs.en: Although the Northern Ireland Executive published a Refugee Integration Strategy to assist newcomers, it lacks specific commitments to improve educational access for older teenagers. Consequently, many young people feel they are starting from zero and urgently need a fair pathway to achieve their potential.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然北愛爾蘭行政院發布了一項難民融合策略來協助新住民，但它缺乏改善較年長青少年教育管道的具體承諾。因此，許多青年感到他們是從零開始，並且迫切需要一條公平的道路來實現他們的潛能。

lessons.title: Stop making sense: focus on sounds to help learn a language, study suggests
lessons.title_zh: 別死背文法：研究指出聚焦聲音有助於學習語言

paragraphs.en: A recent study suggests that if individuals want to master a foreign language like French, Arabic, or Hungarian, they should focus on pronunciation instead of starting with rote learning for vocabulary and grammar. Researchers from University College London (UCL) and Tohoku University in Japan discovered that the brains of the most talented language learners actually process foreign terms as random noise rather than recognizable words.
paragraphs.zh: 一項最新研究顯示，如果個人想要精通法語、阿拉伯語或匈牙利語等外語，應該聚焦於發音，而不是從死背單字和文法開始。來自倫敦大學學院（UCL）與日本東北大學的研究人員發現，最具語言天份的學習者的頭腦，實際上是將外國詞彙視為隨機噪音，而不是可辨識的單字。

paragraphs.en: Normally, people try to understand a new language through the sounds of their native tongue, which can make foreign pronunciation much harder to learn. To find out why top linguists can overcome this challenge, the researchers compared the auditory precision of 67 Japanese learners of English. They measured how well participants could detect slight changes in pitch, length, and tone using non-speech sounds.
paragraphs.zh: 通常人們會透過母語的聲音來理解新語言，這會使得外國發音更難學習。為了找出頂尖語言學家為何能克服這項挑戰，研究人員比較了 67 位學習英語的日本學習者的聽覺精確度。他們使用非語音聲音，測量參與者辨別音高、長度和音調微小變化的能力。

paragraphs.en: The results showed that learners with higher auditory precision mastered new pronunciations much faster and more accurately. Their brain activity patterns were closer to those found when processing non-speech sounds, relying less on the brain's left sensorimotor system for language processing. Professor Kazuya Saito-van Poeteren from the UCL Institute of Education stated, "I do not think British people are biologically bad at languages."
paragraphs.zh: 結果顯示，具有較高聽覺精確度的學習者能更快且更準確地掌握新發音。他們的腦部活動模式較接近處理非語音聲音時的情形，較少依賴大腦用於語言處理的左側感覺運動系統。來自倫敦大學學院教育研究所的齊藤凡波特倫（Kazuya Saito-van Poeteren）教授表示：「我不認為英國人在生物學上不擅長語言。」

paragraphs.en: The researchers explained that many people receive too little meaningful exposure combined with ineffective teaching methods. Learners with high auditory precision can make effective use of sparse input, while others might need much more exposure. Therefore, schools should develop learners' ear for language in line with their auditory characteristics rather than just relying on traditional practice methods.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人員解釋，許多人接受到的有意義接觸太少，再加上教學方法沒有效率。具有高聽覺精確度的學習者能有效利用稀疏的輸入，而其他人則可能需要更多的接觸。因此，學校應該順應學習者的聽覺特徵來培養他們對語言的敏銳度，而不是只依賴傳統的練習方法。

grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」置於句首或句中，用來表達某個動作的目的（回答為什麼）。
grammar.example: To find out why top linguists can overcome this challenge, the researchers compared the auditory precision of 67 Japanese learners of English.
